❖Drawing parabola : 𝑦2 = 4𝑎𝑥
▪Symmetric about x-axis
▪If 𝑝𝑥, 𝑦 is a point on 𝑦2 = 4𝑎𝑥 then 𝑞𝑥, −𝑦 will also be on the curve.
▪ The point (𝑥𝑐, 𝑦𝑐) is a point of the curve where the slope of the curve is 1.
▪For region 𝑅1 [(0,0) to (𝑥𝑐, 𝑦𝑐)], the slope of the parabola is 𝑚> 1, and 
therefore, we will increment 𝑦 and compute corresponding 𝑥 value.
▪For region 𝑅2 (𝑥𝑐, 𝑦𝑐 𝑡𝑜 (𝑥, 𝑦)], the slope of the parabola is 𝑚< 1, and 
therefore, we shall increment 𝑥 and compute corresponding 𝑦 value. 
▪ Use mid-point algo. To avoid floating point operations.

▪ Use mid-point algo. To avoid floating point operations.
